plain: Not wise or fit under the circumstances.

webster.text: Not expedient; not tending to promote a purpose; not tending to a good end; unfit; improper; unsuitable to time and place.

example.quote: As, on the one hand, the form of the provision would not fulfil the intent of its proposers, so, on the other, if I apprehend that intent rightly, it would be in itself inexpedient.
